chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Ibn Abī Naṣr, from Muthannā al-Ḥannāṭ, from Zurārah, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If a man were to dig a well in his house, then another man entered and fell into it, there would be nothing against him, nor would there be liability upon him; but he should cover it.

key_terms.بِئْرًا: a well dug in the ground

ai.seo_question: Is a homeowner liable if someone falls into a well dug inside his own house?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if someone digs a well within his own property and another person enters and falls into it, the owner is not financially liable. However, the Imam عليه السلام instructs that the well should still be covered, indicating precaution and proper care.
